summary.en-US: Send the current page video to a local always-on-top macOS PiP helper window.

description.en-US:
macOS External PiP Bridge connects Firefox video playback to a local helper application running on your Mac. When you click the toolbar button, the extension finds the best video on the active tab and sends either a direct media URL or a fallback encoded media stream to the helper. The helper displays the video in a small always-on-top window.

This add-on does not use a remote server, analytics, advertising, or tracking. The companion macOS helper must be installed and running separately.

version.approval_notes: This add-on requires a separate local macOS helper app. The helper receives video data only after the user clicks the toolbar button. Direct mode sends a playable media URL and limited request headers to the local helper; fallback mode sends MediaRecorder WebM chunks to the local helper. No remote server, analytics, advertising, or tracking are used. See the repository files amo/review-notes.md and PRIVACY.md for the full reviewer notes and privacy policy.

release_notes.en-US: Adds a helper setup page that opens when the Firefox add-on cannot connect to the macOS helper. Improves public install wording.
